title: Team display events.json
description: What publish() writes to web/data/events.json and what web/app.js reads. The events are a copy of the team's Google Calendar. Times are local wall-clock strings with no timezone (America/New_York on the Pi). See docs/SPEC.md.

generated_at.description: When the Pi last wrote this file. The display warns when this is over 60 minutes old.

synced_at.description: When the Google Calendar was last read successfully, or null if never. The display warns when this is over 60 minutes old.

time_synced.description: False when the Pi's clock is not NTP-synced; the display then hides the countdown.

events.description: Sorted by start. Everything whose end (or start, if no end) is on or after yesterday 00:00.

start.description: Start time. For all-day events the time part is 00:00.

end.description: End time, or null. For all-day events: the LAST day (inclusive), at 00:00.
